Who to ban in Mobile Legends: the most dangerous heroes by rank

Hirara is banned in two matches out of three yet wins half her games. We look at who really deserves your ban and who counters them if it is gone.

In this story

  1. Who gets banned the most
  2. Who you should really ban
  3. The right ban depends on your rank
  4. If the ban is gone: who counters them
  5. Strong heroes almost nobody bans
← All news
In this story
Who gets banned the mostWho you should really banThe right ban depends on your rankIf the ban is gone: who counters themStrong heroes almost nobody bans

In brief

  • Hirara is banned the most: in 67.97% of matches across all ranks and 86.38% in Mythical Glory.
  • Yet Hirara wins only 50.03% of matches. Masha (60.40% wins) and Marcel (57.46%) are more dangerous if left open.
  • Belerick is banned in 56.83% of matches across all ranks.
  • Strong heroes almost nobody bans: Valir (54.11% wins at 3.78% bans), Hanabi and Ling.

The comparison covers 30 days ending on 23 November 2026. The tables separate all-rank bans from Mythical Glory bans.

The ban list barely matches the list of the strongest heroes. Hirara is removed in two matches out of three, and when she does get through, her team wins almost exactly half the time. Belerick is banned in 56.83% of matches, although his win rate is 51.83%.

Who you should really ban

Heroes that win most often when left open

Masha wins 60.40% of matches — the most among all 133 heroes — and in Mythical Glory she is banned in 72.41% of matches. Marcel holds 57.46% wins. If the enemy has already banned Hirara in Glory, your ban is better spent on Masha or Marcel than on removing the annoying hero twice.

The right ban depends on your rank

  • Epic and Legend: Belerick wins 55.96% of matches in Epic, so banning him there makes sense. By Mythical Glory his win rate drops to 50.01%.
  • Mythic and Honor: Masha, Marcel and Obsidia hold more than 52% wins at these ranks.
  • Mythical Glory: the enemy almost always removes Hirara (86.38%), so plan your own ban for Masha (72.41%) or Marcel (71.35%).

Strong heroes almost nobody bans

The flip side of bans is the heroes the enemy leaves open. Valir wins 54.11% of matches but is banned in only 3.78%. Hanabi has 52.66% wins at 4.27% bans, Ling 52.54% at 0.62%. You can almost always pick them yourself.

Frequently asked questions

Who is banned the most in Mobile Legends?

Hirara: she is banned in 67.97% of matches across all ranks and 86.38% in Mythical Glory. Belerick, Obsidia and Eudora come next.

Who should I ban in Mythical Glory?

If the enemy has already banned Hirara, the best ban is Masha (60.75% wins in Glory) or Marcel (57.36%).

How do you counter Hirara?

By MOONTON’s statistics Hirara does worst against Hanzo, Karina, X.Borg.
